meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: Claude 会把你 fork 里改过的配置、源码、技能等整理成一份迁移指南；升级上游时，它先拉取干净的上游代码，再按指南重新应用你的自定义修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求把 fork 里的自定义改动迁移到上游版本、或升级 NanoClaw 时触发；若已有指南，会先询问是否直接进入升级。

say.text: 把我在这个 fork 里做的自定义整理成迁移指南
say.note: 它会分析改动并生成指南文件

say.text: 升级到上游，并照迁移指南把我改的东西重新应用回去
say.note: 它在干净上游上重放你的自定义

say.text: 先评估改动规模，再决定走完整迁移还是用 /update-nanoclaw
say.note: 它会提示规模并让你选择路径

howto.what_en: Claude extracts the user's customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a markdown migration guide, then upgrades to upstream by checking out a clean base and reapplying those customizations from the guide, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to migrate customizations from a fork to upstream or upgrade NanoClaw; if a guide already exists, it offers to skip to the upgrade phase.

say_en.text: Extract my customizations from this fork into a migration guide.
say_en.note: It analyzes the changes and writes the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade to upstream and reapply my changes from the migration guide.
say_en.note: It replays your customizations on a clean upstream checkout.

say_en.text: Assess the scope first and decide between full migration or /update-nanoclaw.
say_en.note: It presents the scale and asks how to proceed.
